local-jsonl.durability_ceiling: local JSONL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, and prepared-effect idempotency key reservation; signed terminal effect transition chains, outbox claims, and relay/reconciliation reports are sqlite-wal only in rev0635 and this backend is not distributed or tamper-proof.

sqlite-wal.durability_ceiling: local SQLite/WAL replay ledger plus local simulated downstream SQLite journal; reserve/claim/relay/reconcile evidence is durable on local storage but does not claim distributed exactly-once delivery, external side-effect success, or tamper-proof transparency.
sqlite-wal.effect_outbox_status: Schema v10 creates one effect_outbox row in the same SQLite transaction as each prepared ledger entry, permits one local worker to claim reserved work as inflight under a bounded lease, permits stale-lease reclaim, and terminally updates the same row only inside a signed transition transaction.
sqlite-wal.effect_relay_known_limit: the configured adapter still targets a deterministic local SQLite downstream journal; it prevents per-request selection of adapter/signer/trust/downstream fields but is not yet a real external service adapter, transport authentication boundary, or HSM-backed signer.
sqlite-wal.restore_ceiling: v30 local snapshot restore verifies the replay ledger/outbox/claim state only; external downstream journals remain operator-managed evidence and are not folded into the ledger snapshot.

blocked_claim: Capability manifest is package-local evidence. Rev0636 narrows the relay boundary with digest-pinned operator config, but it is still not a remote delivery proof, HSM custody proof, witness checkpoint, or distributed exactly-once guarantee.
